meta.name: memory-delta-triage
meta.description: Apply three deterministic heuristics to a single memory-delta file to produce a structured verdict block; invoke memory-ingest on ACCEPTED candidates only in validate mode. Activate when Discovery processes a raw memory-delta from contexts/artefacts/memory-deltas/.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对记忆增量文件进行结构化评估与裁决
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要处理原始记忆增量并决定是否导入系统
copy.tagline_en: Apply structured heuristics to memory-delta files and decide intake
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle raw memory-deltas and need to decide whether to ingest

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude对记忆增量文件（memory-delta）应用三项规则检查，产生一个结构化裁决。如果模式是“验证”，还会自动调用记忆摄取功能来写入接受的内容。
howto.when: 当Claude发现一个新的记忆增量文件（位于contexts/artefacts/memory-deltas/）并需要决定是否将其纳入长期记忆时触发。

say.text: 对这个记忆增量执行草案模式裁决。
say.note: 只会生成裁决，不会写入记忆。

say.text: 验证并处理这个记忆增量文件。
say.note: 会对接受的内容调用记忆摄取。

say.text: 检查记忆增量E01S01的合法性。

howto.what_en: This skill applies three heuristics to a memory-delta file, produces a structured verdict block. In 'validate' mode, it instructs Discovery to invoke memory-ingest for accepted candidates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Discovery processes a raw memory-delta from contexts/artefacts/memory-deltas/ and needs an auditable verdict before ingestion.

say_en.text: Run a draft triage on this memory delta.
say_en.note: Only generates verdict, no memory write.

say_en.text: Validate and ingest this memory delta.
Check the memory delta E01S01 schema.
